tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: The open DataHouse tasks: title, kind (video, photo, voice, text), the unpaid verification sample each wants and the rate paid work earns after verification. No key needed. Filter by file kind.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: One task in full: description, the task's own material (instructions: the sentences to read, texts to label, answers to rate), the unpaid verification sample with how-to steps and rules, allowed file kinds, the qualification questions (with ids, for apply_to_task) and the rate paid work earns after

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The account behind the key, whether the basics a task needs are in (legal name, phone, location, occupation), and today's usage.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Save the basics a task needs: legal first and last name, phone in E.164 (+1…), location as "City, Country", occupation (one to five titles, "student" is fine), language.

tools.name: apply_to_task
tools.description: Join a DataHouse task for the person. `answers` maps each question id from get_task to the answer (a string, or a list for multiselect); every required question needs one. Optional preferred rate in their words ("$2 per clip"). One application per task; a task with a sample unlocks its sample step a

tools.name: request_upload
tools.description: A one-time signed URL for ONE sample file of a task the person joined. PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with the returned headers, then call confirm_upload with the path. Kind must match the task; up to 100 MB; up to 10 files per task.

tools.name: confirm_upload
tools.description: After the PUT: register the object at `path` as a sample of the task. Returns how many samples are in and how many the task wants.

tools.name: remove_sample
tools.description: Take back one staged sample (a wrong or bad file) so another can be uploaded in its place. Only before submit_samples. file_id comes from confirm_upload, get_submission or my_submissions.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.description: A one-tap link to this task's upload page on kariaa.com, already signed in, where the person picks their photos, voice notes or videos from their phone or computer. Use it whenever you cannot send the file bytes yourself (chat apps). The link works once, for 15 minutes; give it to the person as is.

tools.name: add_text_sample
tools.description: For a text task: the person's written answer (20 to 20,000 characters), stored as a .txt sample.

tools.name: submit_samples
tools.description: Send the staged samples of a task for review. Needs every sample the task asks for. Optional text_response for notes.

tools.name: my_submissions
tools.description: Every DataHouse task the person joined, newest first, with its stage (pending_review, sample_needed, in_review, approved, rejected).

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: One task the person joined: stage, staged files, review outcome and the next step.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Live job openings for a role, near a place or remote, from job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, national boards) and remote-job sites, newest relevant first, with links to apply on the employer's page. Works without a key. Pass the role as people say it ("electrician", "nurse", "da

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job from search_jobs in full: description, requirements, pay when stated, posted date and the link to apply. Use it to tailor a resume or cover letter to the posting.

tools.name: check_job_post
tools.description: Warning signs in a job post, recruiter message or offer (fees, upfront payments, personal email domains, link shorteners, pressure, requests for ID or bank details), each with the exact quoted line. Rule-based. Pass the text in English; translate it first if needed, keeping amounts, links, phone num

tools.name: estimate_pay
tools.description: What employers state for a role in a city or country, from recent postings that list pay: the typical range, how many postings it comes from, and examples with links. When there are too few, say so and research further yourself.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Keep a job from search_jobs on the person's Kariaa list to come back to. Needs a Kariaa API key.

tools.name: my_saved_jobs
tools.description: The jobs the person saved, newest first, with whether each is still open. Needs a Kariaa API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_link, get_submission, check_job_post · Private data: list_tasks, get_task, request_upload, remove_sample, get_upload_link, get_submission, save_job, my_saved_jobs · Public sink: request_upload, confirm_upload, get_upload_link, submit_samples, check_job_post · Destructive: remove_sample.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_link, get_submission, check_job_post · Private data: list_tasks, get_task, request_upload, remove_sample, get_upload_link, get_submission, save_job, my_saved_jobs · Public sink: request_upload, confirm_upload, get_upload_link, submit_samples, check_job_post · Destructive: remove_sample

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
